lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is narrower and lines are more parallel near the shoulder, becoming wider and more irregular toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the second line from the posterior, splitting in the lower-mid quadrant of the haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed line segments observed on the 3rd and 4th lines from the shoulder; several lines terminate before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 7-9 high-contrast spots located on the upper hind limb and lower haunch area with moderate density.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of three spots on the mid-thigh forming a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the cheek/jaw area; a white horizontal patch on the lower throat; white band markings present on the lower forelegs and hind legs.
